title: Milo goes out of business

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: I'm not cut out for business. That's what happened.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not cut out for business. That's what happened.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: In geological terms, this generational debt stretches down to the core of the planet.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: In geological terms, this generational debt stretches down to the core of the planet.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: And to you, my former business partner. Take care!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And to you, my former business partner. Take care!

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: It's not seismology per se. It's all the financial bullshit that comes with it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's not seismology per se. It's all the financial bullshit that comes with it.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: She then raised the interest payments. Obviously.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She then raised the interest payments. Obviously.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nola Berg didn't agree to be your partner?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nola Berg didn't agree to be your partner?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Nola Berg didn't agree to be your partner?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Nola Berg didn't agree to be your partner?

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: No. And then she destroyed me. Nola Berg bought up the debt contracts for my seismology equipment.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. And then she destroyed me. Nola Berg bought up the debt contracts for my seismology equipment.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: This is where our fate diverges my friend.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This is where our fate diverges my friend.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: I am considering faking my death. I assume you don't need to take such severe steps?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am considering faking my death. I assume you don't need to take such severe steps?

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: Well that's my plan. If I can escape the Debt Corps, I can keep working on my seismology.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well that's my plan. If I can escape the Debt Corps, I can keep working on my seismology.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: Seismology has never let me down, so I'll never let seismology down.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Seismology has never let me down, so I'll never let seismology down.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It really means a lot to you, huh?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It really means a lot to you, huh?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It really means a lot to you, huh?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It really means a lot to you, huh?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're not alone. Seismology is only for the toughest!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're not alone. Seismology is only for the toughest!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You're not alone. Seismology is only for the toughest!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You're not alone. Seismology is only for the toughest!

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: I don't mind CorpSec at the moment. It's Nola Berg that ripped me apart!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't mind CorpSec at the moment. It's Nola Berg that ripped me apart!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Considering everything that's fair play, isn't it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Considering everything that's fair play, isn't it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Considering everything that's fair play, isn't it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Considering everything that's fair play, isn't it?

nodes.text: // all of Milo's venues go over to Nola
